steps.title: Check the documents
steps.prompt: Run "Check documents": each paper on file is checked against the onboarding rules; the result card lists each one, valid or what is wrong.

steps.title: Verify the ID document (Onfido)
steps.prompt: Run "Verify document": Onfido checks the applicant's ID live and matches the selfie to it; the result card shows each check.

steps.title: Screen the applicant (ComplyAdvantage)
steps.prompt: Run "Screen against sanctions lists": the result card lists each name checked and any match.

steps.title: Read the deciding evidence
steps.prompt: Read all 5 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Automatic check · Result", "Documents · Complete", "ID checks · Result", "Screening · Result" and "Risk · Suggested rating".

steps.title: Clean file?
steps.prompt: Clean when "Automatic check · Result" is CLEAN: documents complete, every ID and selfie passed, nobody found by the screening, suggested rating LOW. Anything else goes to a person, with the first check that failed.

steps.title: Approve KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Approve KYC": the risk rating is the pre-score (LOW); the case is decided by the service account and the customer becomes active.

steps.title: Hand the file to a person
steps.prompt: Run "Hand to a person": the robot started the review, so the case leaves its service account; the result card says which check did not come back clean.

steps.title: Review the file
steps.prompt: The robot paused here: a check did not come back clean (the step above says which). Read "ID checks · Result" and "Documents · Complete" in the Case tab and open the ID in the Documents tab, then click Done and decide.

steps.title: Onboard this customer?
steps.prompt: Your decision. An ID cut off or with another name: ask for a new ID, or reject. Approve only when every check shows ✓: Approve KYC refuses an ID that failed or needs a closer look.

steps.title: Approve KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Approve KYC" with the risk rating decided: it refuses when a document, an ID or a screening hit is still open.

steps.title: Request a new ID document
steps.prompt: Run "Request ID document": the applicant gets a request in the app to upload a valid ID, with the reason Onfido gave.

steps.title: Request the missing documents
steps.prompt: Run "Request missing documents": the request is pre-filled with what the file lacks.

steps.title: Reject KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Reject KYC": the reason is pre-filled from the failed checks.
